title: What F5 BIG-IP LB Teams Build

scenes.line1: What does the LB team really build?
scenes.line2: Can you name the F5 objects?
scenes.say: If you request a new VIP, do you know what the load balancer team actually configures behind the scenes?

rows.b: Group of nodes, port, health check

scenes.say: It starts with nodes, which are just backend server addresses. Then pools group those nodes, set the port, add health checks, and define load balancing. Finally, a virtual server ties it all together with a VIP, port, and profiles like SSL.

scenes.label: SNAT
scenes.sub: Makes backend replies flow through the F5
scenes.say: SNAT is often set to automap, so backend servers always reply through the F5. Without it, connections break.

scenes.title: F5 tmsh examples
scenes.say: These tmsh commands show the actual objects: the virtual server, the pool and its members, and the health monitor.

scenes.question: What does the LB team configure for a VIP?
scenes.wrong: Just the VIP address and port
scenes.right: Node, pool, virtual server, profiles, SNAT, and health checks
scenes.say: In an interview, don't just say VIP and port. List out the node, pool, virtual server, profiles, SNAT, and health checks. That's what really gets built.
